name: Commonwealth Prac Payment
summary: A weekly payment while you are on a mandatory placement in teaching, nursing, midwifery or social work.
who: Entry-to-practice degrees in teaching, nursing, midwifery and social work, plus the VET Diploma of Nursing.
You need a Commonwealth supported place and a mandatory placement averaging 30 or more hours a week.
how: Higher education students apply through their education provider.
catches: It is taxable income, so declare it in your tax return.
Official pages currently disagree on the weekly amount for 2026, so none is shown. Ask your provider for the current rate.
Other conditions apply. Check the details with your provider.
